commits.messageBody:
Use RtlCaptureContext and AMD64 StackWalk64 with the real thread handle and native system DbgHelp on x64. Serialize complete DbgHelp operations. Bypass the retained function-table pointer cache on x64: native known-chain probes fail with it and recover when only that cache is bypassed; changing the module-base cache alone does not recover.

This server Windows translation unit was built and exercised against the real client dependency closure under v120 Debug/Release, Win32/x64: 257/257 captures each including concurrent walks and source lookup. Linux stack code is unchanged. Quiescent install/remove, module unload/reload, minidump lifecycle and complete server runtime remain outside this test.

(cherry picked from commit 742878485cfded30843d7160ba85de48d0e43333)
